title: The bird before the thirtieth
logline: The flyer wall with twenty-nine flyers and a bare space at the end where the thirtieth will go on the 12th, and the bird sitting in the bare space. The last flyer page before the last flyer.

panels.composition: A shingle wall with a long row of paper flyers and a bare space at its end, the small rainbow bird perched on the shingle in the bare space.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a shingle wall with a long row of paper flyers ending in a bare space where a small rainbow bird perches on the shingle, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: In the space for the thirtieth.
